start: Messages & offers page, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Messages & offers
user_sees: Title 'Messages & offers', line 'Messages, offers and wishes for your members, in the app and on WhatsApp', tabs 'Messages', 'Workout offer', 'Reminders'
must_not: The 'Messages' tab missing for an owner
A message sent just by opening the page

steps.action: Pick a ready message, pick 'Language of the message' (English, Hindi or Both), choose a group and open 'WhatsApp one by one'
user_sees: Sheet 'WhatsApp one by one'
'1 of {n}: {name}' and '{n} done so far'
Left-out lines: '{n} without a full mobile number left out', '{n} sharing a number with someone above, sent once'
must_not: A person with a half mobile number in the queue
The same shared number messaged twice with the same words
Anything sent without the owner's tap in WhatsApp

steps.action: Send to each person in turn until the end
user_sees: 'All {n} done.' with 'Start the list again'; or 'End of the list. {n} not sent yet.' with 'Go to the first one not sent'
must_not: 'All done' while someone was skipped
Done ticks lost when the sheet is closed and opened again with the same words

start: A member row on Today, Members or the member's page

steps.action: Tap the WhatsApp button on the member
user_sees: Sheet 'WhatsApp {name}' with 'Which message' chips that fit this member (for example Plan ending, Fees due, Birthday), 'Language of the message' and 'Message (you can change it)' filled in
must_not: A message kind that does not fit the member (a birthday wish on another day)
Another member's name, dates or amount in the words

steps.action: Change a few words, tap the send button
user_sees: WhatsApp opens for that member's number with the changed words
must_not: WhatsApp opened for another number
The message sent by the panel itself

start: Members list with a filter that has a ready message (Has dues, Expired, Expiring, birthday)

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp all {n}, one by one'
user_sees: Sheet '{message name} · one by one' with '1 of {n}: {name}', '{n} sent so far', buttons 'Back', 'Skip' (then 'Next' once sent) and 'Done' on the last person
must_not: The list changing under the thumb when a member pays mid-way
A person without a full number counted in '{n}'

start: WhatsApp sheet for a member whose mobile number is not complete

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp sheet for that member
user_sees: 'This mobile number is not complete, so WhatsApp can’t open it. Tap Edit on their page to fix it.' and a send button that cannot be pressed
must_not: WhatsApp opening with a broken number
No word on why the button is off

steps.action: Open a one-by-one list where nobody has a full number
user_sees: 'Nobody on this list has a full mobile number.' (or 'Nobody in this group has a full mobile number.')
must_not: An empty '1 of 0' line

steps.action: Look for Messages & offers in the menu and open /messages
user_sees: Page titled 'Workout offer' with 'Rewards for members who train', tabs 'Workout offer' and 'Reminders' only
must_not: The 'Messages' tab or a send-to-group button for staff
A blank page
A send that the server refuses only after staff wrote the message

steps.action: Open a member row and tap the WhatsApp button
user_sees: The same 'WhatsApp {name}' sheet as the owner, for one member
must_not: Group sending from the Messages section for staff

start: One-by-one sheet half way through a group

steps.action: Send to 3 of 10, tap 'Done', open the same message and group again
user_sees: The sheet opens on the first person not done, '3 done so far'
must_not: Starting again at person 1
Ticks carried over to a message with new words

steps.action: Reach the end, tap 'Start the list again'
user_sees: '1 of {n}', '0 done so far'
must_not: Ticks of another gym or another message cleared

steps.action: Switch 'Language of the message' from English to Hindi
user_sees: The ready words in Hindi for this and every later person; the choice is remembered in this browser for this gym
must_not: The panel's own screens turning Hindi
Half-English half-Hindi words unless 'Both' is picked

start: '{message} · one by one' sheet from the Members list

steps.action: Send to the first person, tap 'Next', tap 'Back'
user_sees: '1 of {n}: {name} · sent' and '1 sent so far'
must_not: The sent mark lost on going back
The count going up twice for one person

steps.action: Change the words for person 2, then switch the language
user_sees: The ready words in the new language; hand-changed words are dropped
must_not: Hand-changed words of one member shown for another member

start: Signed in as front desk, an old link to /shop/messages or /messages

steps.action: Open the old Shop to Messages link
user_sees: The Shop page (or the Workout offer page for /messages), never the owner's Messages section
must_not: The owner's group-message screen
An error page

start: Messages & offers, a personal message group

steps.action: Read the note on personal messages and send one
user_sees: 'Sent on WhatsApp only, one member at a time, each with their own name and dates.'; each message opens in the owner's own WhatsApp
must_not: One member's dues or dates sent to another member
A group chat that shows members each other's numbers
The message stored on the MettleUp server as sent

steps.action: Open the sheet for a member with dues
user_sees: That member's own name, dues and dates in the words
must_not: Gym money totals in the words
Members of another branch reachable
